newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks seen weakening on builders' failures.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks seen weakening on builders' failures.

text.p: Tokyo stocks are expected to weaken on Wednesday as a series of failures of Japanese construction firms will likely discourage market sentiment, brokers said.
On Tuesday, the Nikkei 225 average finished down 80.10 points or 0.42 percent at 18,961.00. Nikkei September futures fell 70 points to 18,930.
"Yesterday's failure of Daito Kogyo will likely prompt selling in other construction firms today," said a market analyst at a medium-sized Japanese brokerage.
Brokers pointed to a lack of sectors to lead the market upward.
Many high-tech issues, which have been a buying target of foreign investors, declined on Tuesday despite New York stocks' firm rebound from last week's drop.
Market participants are also concerned about continuing general weakness in the Japanese economy, brokers said.
Market sources predicted trade in a range between 18,700 and 19,300 points on the Nikkei 225.
